mage.title: Mage, 1 to 50
mage.intro: The Planner's leveling guide written out for a Mage, 1 to 50: where to train, where your points go and what to wear, with every road the community's guides take side by side. The numbers are the calculator's own.

start.heading: 1 to 10
start.text: Levels 1 to 10 are Maple Island. Put every ability point into INT and talk to Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia at level 8 to become a Magician. From here the guide follows the Planner.

jobs.name: Fire/Poison Wizard
jobs.line: Fire and Poison hit hardest on their own, with no party needed.

jobs.name: Ice/Lightning Wizard
jobs.line: Ice holds monsters still and Lightning hits a crowd, so a crowded map goes fast.

jobs.name: Cleric
jobs.line: Heal hits the undead and keeps a party up, so Clerics are wanted everywhere.
